name: Shaanxi Aerospace Power Hi-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Aerospace Power Hi-Tech Co., Ltd., based in Xi'an, China since its establishment in 1999, is a manufacturer and distributor of advanced industrial equipment within the Chinese market. The company's diverse product range includes pumps, electric motors, torque converters, precision gas and fluid measurement instruments, hydraulic systems, and specialized biological and chemical apparatus. These products are widely utilized in critical industries such as petroleum, chemical processing, metallurgy, transportation, energy generation, heavy engineering, public services, and defense. Additionally, the firm has an international presence, exporting its manufactured goods to approximately 20 countries and regions spanning Southeast Asia, South America, Europe, and Africa.
